_comment: Merge this block into your Claude Desktop config file. The wizard's 'Install the Creator OS tools' step (python3 tools/wizard.py, then Claude Desktop Setup) writes the creator-os entry for you and verifies it; the connector entries are written when you connect those services. This file remains the manual fallback and reference.
_config_path_windows_packaged: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Packages\Claude_<id>\LocalCache\Roaming\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json (the Microsoft Store / MSIX build; Claude Desktop's %LOCALAPPDATA%\Claude\logs\main.log names the file it reads)

creator-os._comment: Use an ABSOLUTE interpreter path. Claude Desktop launches this with its own (narrow) PATH, so a bare 'python3' can fail to start. After running setup, use the private toolbox interpreter created for you: REPLACE_WITH_ABSOLUTE_PATH/seo-tools/.venv/bin/python3 (if you did not run the dependency install, use your absolute python3 from `which python3`). Then completely Quit Claude Desktop (Cmd-Q) and reopen it; the config is only read at launch. Errors appear in ~/Library/Logs/Claude/mcp-server-creator-os.log.

google-workspace._comment: Optional. Added by wizard when you connect Google. Requires uv (user-only: the wizard installs it into the repo private .venv, or curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh puts it in ~/.local/bin). Covers Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, and Sheets.

microsoft-365._comment: Optional. Added by wizard when you connect Microsoft. Requires Node.js 20+. Covers Outlook, Calendar, Excel, OneDrive, and 200+ Microsoft 365 tools.

wolfram-alpha._comment: Optional. Exact symbolic computation. Free tier: 2,000 calls/month. Get App ID at developer.wolframalpha.com.

e2b-code-interpreter._comment: Optional. Sandboxed Python with scipy/numpy/pandas/matplotlib. Get API key at e2b.dev.

stats-compass._comment: Optional. 50+ pandas-based statistical tools. No API key needed.

duckdb-analytics._comment: Optional. Analytical SQL over CSV, Parquet and JSON files in an in-memory DuckDB database, without an API key. The server refuses an in-memory database without --read-write; with it, a query can change the database and write files, and the database lasts as long as the server process. Requires uv. Use uvx's ABSOLUTE path as the command, since Claude Desktop may not see your terminal's PATH (on a Mac it starts servers with a narrow PATH) and setup does not add its .venv to PATH. For the uv that setup installs, that is REPLACE_WITH_ABSOLUTE_PATH/seo-tools/.venv/bin/uvx (on Windows REPLACE_WITH_ABSOLUTE_PATH\seo-tools\.venv\Scripts\uvx.exe); for a uv installed another way, it is the path `which uvx` (Mac, Linux) or `where.exe uvx` (Windows, in PowerShell or Command Prompt) prints. In this file a Windows path's backslashes are written doubled.

jupyter-notebook._comment: Optional. Persistent Jupyter notebook sessions. No API key needed.
